description: The line plot, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates the performance of different model variants on three metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—measured in percentage. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," displays five distinct configurations: "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)," ranges from 58 to 66, with a linear scale. The legend indicates that the purple line with circular markers represents Precision, the blue line with circular markers represents Recall, and the brown line with circular markers represents F1-score. The "Full model (Ours)" achieves the highest scores for all three metrics, with Precision at 65.45%, Recall at 65.78%, and F1-score at 65.45%. The "w/o Prompt" variant shows a significant drop in all metrics, with Precision at 61.06%, Recall at 59.64%, and F1-score at 60.16%. The "w/o Augmentation" variant shows a slight increase in Precision to 62.22% and F1-score to 62.63%, while Recall peaks at 64.06%. The "w/o Attention" variant shows a decline in all metrics, with Precision at 64.06%, Recall at 59.17%, and F1-score at 59.67%. The "w/o Prompt & Augmentation" variant shows the lowest scores, with Precision at 65.44%, Recall at 56.82%, and F1-score at 57.74%.
